newsitem.title: USA: Public Service approves dividend plans.
newsitem.headline: Public Service approves dividend plans.

text.p: Public Service Co of Colorado's board of directors approved two options for declaring quarterly dividends on all outstanding common stock -- depending on the timing of U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission approval of the company's pending merger with Southwestern Public Service Co.

If the merger were effective on or before July 12, the board would set a prorated dividend to common shareholders accruing at a pre-calculated daily rate from April 12 (the day following the last record date for dividends paid on the company's common stock) through the day prior to the merger.
If the merger were effective after July 12, the board would set a normal quarterly dividend of $0.525 per share payable August 1 to shareholders of record on July 11.

Additionally, the board would declared a continued prorated dividend that would accrue at a pre-calculated daily rate from July 12 through the day prior to the merger completion, as long as the merger were effective on or before August 5.

If the merger had not been completed on or before August 5, this continued prorated dividend declaration would no longer be in effect. Instead, the board said it would reconsider the anticipated merger timing and declare a dividend and set an appropriate record date.
Public Service is a Colorado electric and gas utility.
